data.title: Energean posts 54% jump in nine-month profit helped by higher oil prices
data.description:
Eastern Mediterranean gas producer Energean on Thursday posted a 54% jump in profit in the nine months to September 30 helped by higher oil prices and strong performance from its operated Italian oil fields.

  • The company said realised liquids prices rose 44% to $88 per barrel, driven by stronger oil markets and reported net profit of $317 million in the nine months to September 30 compared with $206 million a year ago

  • Energean stuck to its production forecast for the year

  • The company said Katlan, its offshore gas development in Israel, remains on track for first gas in the second quarter of 2027, with total development spending expected at about $1.25 billion

  • The company declared a third-quarter dividend of 10 cents per share and said it expects to return about $110 million to shareholders in 2026

  • Talks between the London-listed company and BP on the sale of BP's Egyptian oil and gas assets have stalled due to a lack of support from Egyptian authorities, Reuters reported earlier this week

data.title: ANT: Anthropic Prices $81 Billion IPO at $83, Sets Stage for Largest-Ever Trading Debut
data.description:
Key points:
  • $83 IPO tests appetite for AI
  • $1.5T valuation raises the stakes
  • Growth surges; compute costs loom

Claude developer heads to public markets at a roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation.

🔔 Anthropic arrives with an $83 price tag

  • Anthropic is expected to begin trading on Nasdaq today under after pricing its IPO at $83 a share. The company confirmed the terms Wednesday, exceeding its original $70–78 range as investors sought exposure to the business behind Claude.
  • The offering expanded to 980 million shares from the initially planned 825 million, putting its gross value at $81.3 billion, the biggest-ever IPO.
  • Anthropic is selling about 956.4 million shares, with existing shareholders selling the remainder. Most proceeds therefore go toward funding the company rather than cashing out investors.
  • Underwriters also have a 30-day option to buy another 147 million shares, potentially increasing the offering further. Today’s opening market price can differ substantially from the $83 allocation price, making the first trade a fresh valuation decision for investors buying through their brokerage accounts.

💰 Trillion-dollar valuation meets real costs

  • The IPO values Anthropic at roughly $1.1 trillion on outstanding shares, or $1.5 trillion including securities such as options and restricted stock. Reuters reported those figures alongside a separate $26 billion private placement.
  • Third-quarter revenue reached $16.96 billion, up 47% from the previous quarter. Annualized revenue run rate reached $81 billion by October 31, according to its filing. That run rate extrapolates the recent pace of business; it does not mean Anthropic has already booked $81 billion in annual revenue.
  • The spending requirements are equally substantial. Anthropic reported a $567 million quarterly operating loss and nearly $900 billion in computing commitments with infrastructure partners.
  • Those commitments extend into the future, leaving investors to assess whether growing customer demand can support the capacity being contracted.

data.title: Sage Group FY26 Results Climb, Lifts Dividend; Sees Growth In FY27
data.description:
LONDON (dpa-AFX) - Sage Group plc (SGE.L), a British enterprise software company, reported Thursday higher profit and revenues in fiscal 2026. Regarding the outlook, Sage said it enters fiscal 2027 with strong momentum.

For the new year, the company expects organic total revenue growth to be in the region of 10 percent. Underlying operating margins are expected to continue trending upwards, with an expected around 100 million pounds non-underlying restructuring charge.

In fiscal 2026, profit before income tax grew to 527 million pounds from last year's 484 million pounds. Profit attributable to Owners of the parent increased to 401 million pounds from prior year's 369 million pounds.

Earnings per share were 42.81 pence, up from 37.16 pence a year ago.

Underlying basic earnings per share increased 16 percent to 50.1 pence, compared to 43.3 pence last year.

Revenue for the year increased 11 percent to 2.78 billion pounds from last year's 2.51 billion pounds, reflecting broad-based growth across the Group driven by strong demand for our solutions and services.

Annualised Recurring Revenue or ARR was 2.88 billion pounds, up 12 percent year-over-year.

Further, the Board proposed final dividend of 15.55p per share, taking the total dividend for the year to 23.60p, up 8 percent compared to the prior year.

The final dividend will be paid on February 9, 2027, to shareholders who are on the register of members on January 8, 2027.

data.title: Alzinova plans a blinded twelve-month interim analysis and a separate futility analysis in ADVANCE
data.description:
Alzinova AB (“Alzinova” or the “Company”) today announces the planned interim analyses in the Company's Phase 2a study ADVANCE (ALZ-C-002) of its therapeutic vaccine ALZ-101 in early Alzheimer's disease. The plan comprises a twelve-month blinded interim analysis and a separate non-binding futility analysis. The planned analyses have been discussed with the Company's expert panel, including Professor Marwan Sabbagh, Global Principal Investigator for the ADVANCE study.

Twelve-month blinded interim analysis

When half of participants have completed the Week 52 assessment, a blinded interim analysis is planned. It will assess biomarkers and clinical measures at Week 52, including plasma phosphorylated tau-217 (p-tau217) and the Alzheimer's Disease Composite Score (ADCOMS). As the analysis will be performed on pooled data, without revealing treatment assignment, it is intended to provide an early indication of biomarker activity and clinical effect alongside safety and tolerability while maintaining the integrity of the ongoing study. Subject to enrolment, and study progression, this analysis is currently expected to be reportable around the third quarter of 2028.

Non-binding futility analysis

A non-binding futility analysis is planned for the third quarter of 2028, at the same timepoint as the twelve-month interim analysis, once approximately 50% of participants have completed the Week 52 assessment of the primary endpoint. It will be performed by independent, unblinded statisticians.

The futility analysis is designed to assess whether the available interim data support continuation of the study towards its final analysis. It is a safeguard and designed to recommend stopping the study only if the interim data make it unlikely that the primary endpoint will be met at the final analysis. As the analysis is non-binding, any recommendation will form part of the overall assessment of the study and will not in itself require the Company to stop the trial. As previously communicated, results from ADVANCE are anticipated in late 2029.

Professor Marwan Sabbagh, Global Principal Investigator for the ADVANCE study, comments:“I have spent a good part of my career watching Alzheimer’s programmes wait years for a single cognitive readout and then discover that the biology was already telling us something. That is no longer an acceptable way to run a Phase 2a study. A blinded interim look at biomarkers and clinical effect, including p-tau217 and ADCOMS, while an independent group tests whether the study is futile, is the right use of an interim. It will tell us, much earlier than 2029, whether this programme deserves the time, the participants and the capital required to finish the study.”

About the ADVANCE study

ADVANCE is a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2a study evaluating the clinical activity, safety, tolerability, immunogenicity and biomarker effects of ALZ-101 in approximately 120 participants aged 50–85 years with early Alzheimer's disease, defined as mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or mild dementia due to Alzheimer's disease according to NIA-AA criteria. The primary endpoint is the effect of ALZ-101 versus placebo on clinical progression, measured as change from baseline in the Alzheimer's Disease Composite Score (ADCOMS) through Week 52. The study is being conducted in the United States, the European Union and the United Kingdom. Results are anticipated in late 2029.

About ALZ-101

ALZ-101 is Alzinova's lead candidate, a therapeutic vaccine against Alzheimer's disease. Alzinova's patented AβCC peptide technology makes it possible to develop disease-modifying treatments that target the toxic amyloid-beta oligomers believed to be central to the onset and development of the disease with great accuracy. ALZ-101 has received Fast Track designation from the US FDA.

For further information, please contact:

Tord Labuda, CEO

E-mail: IR@alzinova.com

About Alzinova

Alzinova AB is a Swedish biopharmaceutical company in clinical development specializing in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, with a focus on targeting toxic amyloid-beta oligomers. The lead candidate ALZ-101 is a therapeutic vaccine against Alzheimer's disease. Alzinova's patented AβCC peptide technology makes it possible to develop disease-modifying treatments that target the toxic amyloid-beta oligomers that are central to the onset and development of the disease with great accuracy. From a global perspective, Alzheimer's disease is one of the most common and devastating neurological diseases, with around 40 million people affected today. Based on the same technology, the company is also developing the antibody ALZ-201, which is currently in preclinical development, as well as the diagnostic project ALZ-401, which aims to develop a blood test to identify an increased risk of Alzheimer's disease before symptoms appear. The goal is to further expand the pipeline. The company's Certified Adviser on Nasdaq First North Growth Market is Mangold Fondkommission AB. For more information about Alzinova, please visit: www.alzinova.com

data.title: JD Sports Fashion Q3 Organic Sales Down 1.1%; Updates FY27 Guidance
data.description:
LONDON (dpa-AFX) - JD Sports Fashion plc (JD.L) reported that its third quarter organic sales declined 1.1%. For 13 weeks to 31 October, comparable sales were down 1.8%, while LFL sales declined 2.6%. Looking forward, JD Sports Fashion narrowed fiscal 2027 profit before tax and adjusting items guidance range to 700 million to 750 million pounds, from prior guidance range of 700 million to 800 million pounds. Free cash flow guidance is unchanged.

Régis Schultz, CEO of JD Sports Fashion, said: 'At Group level, trading in the quarter was in line with our expectations. North America improved on second quarter, our Sporting Goods and Outdoor businesses performed well, and sales trends in apparel and accessories were resilient. In the UK and Europe, cooler weather in October began to bring through some of the autumn/winter demand delayed by unseasonably warm weather earlier in the quarter, although trading in Europe was affected by civil unrest.'

At prior close on LSE, JD Sports Fashion shares were trading at 94.32 pence.

About Implantica

Implantica is a medtech company focused on bringing advanced implantable technologies into the body designed to improve patient outcomes and quality of life. The company's lead product, RefluxStop®, is an FDA approved and CE-marked implant for the treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) with the potential to transform the standard of care in anti-reflux surgery, supported by strong long-term clinical outcomes.

In addition to RefluxStop®, Implantica has developed a broad, patent-protected product pipeline partly incorporating two platform technologies: an eHealth platform designed to enable communication with and remote monitoring and control of implants inside the body, and a wireless energizing platform designed to wirelessly power implantable devices through intact skin. These investigational devices are intended to facilitate remote changes to treatment, potentially saving cost for society.

Implantica is listed on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market (ticker: IMP A SDB). Visit www.implantica.com for further information.

About RefluxStop®

RefluxStop® is a treatment for GERD designed to address the root cause of acid reflux. Conventional anti-reflux surgical procedures typically rely on encircling the esophagus and are often associated with side effects such as swallowing difficulties, inability to belch or vomit, and gas bloating. RefluxStop is different and aims to restore and maintain the lower esophageal sphincter in its natural anatomical position without encircling or applying pressure on the food passageway. Commercial performance from a multitude of centers supports the clinical study data collected and shows that the RefluxStop® device can successfully treat GERD without wrapping or constricting the esophageal sphincter, thereby avoiding the side effects commonly seen with the other current treatment approaches. Long-term 5-year clinical outcomes on RefluxStop® have been published in peer-reviewed scientific journals and support that a significant portion of the patient population will achieve clinically meaningful results, with minimal risks, when used in accordance with the indications for use.

Indications for Use: RefluxStop® is an implantable sterile medical device intended to treat acid and non-acid reflux in patients diagnosed with gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). The device ensures maintenance of a normal physiological situation for the gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) in a defined intra-abdominal position, allowing natural physiological function of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), thereby reducing or eliminating acid and non-acid reflux. The RefluxStop® Deployment Tool is indicated for patients diagnosed with Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), defined by abnormal impedance pH and/or pH testing, and indicated for RefluxStop® implantation.
